title: Marriage of Michel Houle and Genevieve Cartier, Saint-Michel-d'Yamaska, 24 February 1829
proves: Read from the register image (1809-1829 volume, image 598, entry 9). Married 24 February 1829 at Saint-Michel-d'Yamaska: Michel Houle, farmer, adult son of Joseph Houle, farmer, and the late Jeanne Loiseau dite Cardin; Genevieve Cartier, a minor, daughter of Louis Cartier and Dorothee Ritchot. Witnesses Joseph Houle, father of the groom, Jean Houle, his brother, and Louis Cartier, father of the bride.

title: Marriage of Joseph and Jeanne Loiseau, Saint-Pierre-de-Sorel, 1 February 1796
proves: Read from the register image (1749-1802 volume, image 513, right page). Married 1 February 1796 at Sorel: a groom written only as Joseph, of age, farmer, with no surname and no parents; the banns were also read at Maska on a certificate from Father Dugas. Bride Jeanne Loiseau, of age, daughter of Jean-Baptiste Loiseau-Cardin and the late Jeanne Cary (reading uncertain; possibly Fary). Nobody signed.

title: Marriage of Louis Cartier and Dorothee Ritchot, Saint-Michel-d'Yamaska, 12 January 1807

Married 12 January 1807 at Yamaska: Louis Cartier dit Gaguet (reading uncertain), farmer, adult son of the late Louis Cartier and Madeleine Allard; Dorothee Ritchot, of age, daughter of the late Michel Ritchot and Marguerite Crevier.

title: Burial of Michel Ritchot, Saint-Michel-d'Yamaska, 8 November 1793
proves: Read from the register image (1775-1809 volume, image 308, right page, first entry). Buried 8 November 1793, having died the day before, aged 47, husband of Marguerite Crevier. The act names no parents, although the FamilySearch index of it lists Joseph Ritchot and Anne Giroux.

title: Marriage of Michel Ritchot and Marguerite Crevier dit St-Francois, Saint-Francois-du-Lac, 30 January 1775
proves: Read from the register image (1749-1795 volume, image 235, foot of the left page running onto the right). Married 30 January 1775: Michel Ritchot, written Richotte, son of the late Joseph Ritchot and Marie-Anne Giroux; Marguerite Crevier St-Francois, daughter of the late Charles Crevier and the late Charlotte Diel. Witness Joseph Crevier St-Francois.
